headline: Elisha Project and Downtown Gateway Development, Pawtucket High School construction report, and Teamsters Local 251 water board contract.
summary: The agenda covers the Elisha Project and Downtown Gateway Development, a Pawtucket High School construction report, and a Teamsters Local 251 contract. It also lists damage claims against the city and pension board appointments.
items: Pawtucket High School construction report from Colliers Project Leaders
Letter from Councilor-At-Large Yesenia Rubio about The Elisha Project and Downtown Gateway Development
Fraternal Order of Police appointment of Detective Sergeant Andrew Torres to the Police/Fire Pension Board
Letter from Joseph A. Keough, Jr. about the PWSB Teamsters Local 251 contract
Collective Bargaining Agreement between Teamsters Local 251 and the Pawtucket Water Supply Board, July 1, 2026 to June 30, 2029, referred to the Finance Committee
Parking lot lease renewal for 43 Broad Street from Joshua's LLC d/b/a News Café, referred to the City Property Committee

Claims for damages referred to the Committee on Claims and Pending Suits: Lisa Jones $300.00 (Pothole); Norka Quezada $1,350.00 (Pothole); Megan Loiselle $375.00 (Vehicle Damage); Irma Velez-Parent $94.00 (Property Damage)
Claims for damages referred to the Law Department and RI Interlocal Trust: Joshua Overdeep by Daigle Law $500,000.00 (Personal Injury); Dale McGhee by Munro-Delotto Law, LLC $1,500,000.00 (School)
RI Energy petition for installation of a new pole at George St., to be approved pending approval from the Director of Public Works
Appointment by Council President Mercer of Ann-Marie McGee to the Pension Board, term expiring the 1st Monday in January 2028
Reappointment by Council President Mercer of Agueda Del Borgo to the Arts Panel Review Committee, term expiring June 1, 2029
Appointment of BCI Detective Mark Ramos as a retired member of the Pawtucket Police Department on the Pension Board, for confirmation
location: Pawtucket Municipal Annex, 100 Freight Street, 2nd Floor – Temporary Council Chambers
